title.zh: v2.0.60 测试桩守卫：新增节点类型不再以「崩」代替「断言不成立」
title.en: v2.0.60 A Guard for Test Doubles: a New Node Type Fails an Assertion Instead of Crashing the Suite

highlights.zh: **问题**：`velocityTimbreCoverage` / `keyTracking` / `audioDspGuards` 各自手写一份「按节点类型逐个打桩」的 AudioContext 假对象。立体声展开一加 `ChannelSplitter`，前两份就以 `ctx.createChannelSplitter is not a function` 崩掉——报错**与它们要测的东西毫无关系**，而且失败形态是「测试崩了」而不是「断言不成立」。更糟的是没被跑到的那部分**等于没测**，不是「跳过」。
highlights.en: **The problem**: `velocityTimbreCoverage`, `keyTracking` and `audioDspGuards` each hand-rolled an AudioContext double with one stub per node type. When the stereo unison stage added a `ChannelSplitter`, two of them died with `ctx.createChannelSplitter is not a function` — an error that says **nothing about what those suites test**, and whose failure mode is a *crash* rather than a failed assertion. Worse, the part that never ran was **not tested at all**, which is not the sa…

highlights.zh: **处置**：`keyTracking` 迁移到共享的 `FakeOfflineAudioContext`（实现完整图 API，并且会像浏览器一样对非法 ramp 目标抛错）。`audioDspGuards` 保留自己的最小桩——它故意只实现「指数 ramp 对 ≤0 抛错」这一条浏览器行为——但补上了缺失的 `createChannelSplitter` / `createChannelMerger`，并新增守卫测试：**桩必须实现这 13 个 `create*` 工厂**，且与共享 fake 的清单一致。
highlights.en: **The fix**: `keyTracking` moved to the shared `FakeOfflineAudioContext`, which implements the whole graph API and throws on the same illegal ramp targets a browser does. `audioDspGuards` keeps its deliberately minimal double — it reproduces exactly one browser behaviour, `exponentialRampToValueAtTime` throwing for a target ≤ 0 — but gained the missing `createChannelSplitter` / `createChannelMerger` plus a guard test asserting the double implements all 13 `create*` factories…

highlights.zh: **守卫当场抓到一个真实缺口**：`createBuffer` 也没实现。此前没有任何测试把带 `noiseMix` 的预设喂给这个桩，所以它没爆——也就是说噪声床这条路径在这份桩上是完全空白的。已补上。这正是守卫的价值：它把一个「迟早会以崩的形式出现」的缺口，变成一个**现在就红**的断言。
highlights.en: **The guard immediately found a second real gap**: `createBuffer` was missing too. Nothing had fed a preset with `noiseMix` to that double, so it never crashed — meaning the noise-bed path was entirely blank on it. Now implemented. That is the point of the guard: it turns a gap that would eventually surface as a crash into an assertion that is **red right now**.
